heading_en: Notification of Changes Regarding Trading Desks Using the Internal Model Approach
summary_ja: 承認を受けた最終指定親会社の変更届出義務と、要件を満たさなくなった場合の改善計画等の提出を定める。
summary_en: Requires an approved Ultimate Designated Parent Company to notify changes without delay and to submit an improvement plan or a materiality explanation where a desk ceases to meet the requirements.
paragraphs: An Ultimate Designated Parent Company that has obtained the approval under Article 249-4, paragraph (1) shall, where any of the following items applies, submit to the Commissioner of the Financial Services Agency without delay a notification of change stating that fact and its details. (i) Where there has been a change in the matters stated in the application for approval. (ii) Where there has been a material change in the matters stated in the documents attached to the application for approval. (iii) Where grounds have arisen by reason of which the trading desk does not satisfy the requirements listed in the items of Article 249-3, paragraph (3).

Where grounds prescribed in item (iii) of the preceding paragraph have arisen, an Ultimate Designated Parent Company that has obtained the approval under Article 249-4, paragraph (1) shall promptly submit either a document stating an improvement plan regarding those grounds or a document stating an explanation that those grounds are not material from the viewpoint of that Ultimate Designated Parent Company's risk.
